bridge.lede: microspec OS turns the phone into something an agent can drive. It runs a local **MCP** server: a terminal, or Claude, speaks JSON-RPC to it and the phone answers. With the accessibility service on it can drive any app like a person — read the screen, tap, type, scroll — on top of the system controls below. The server binds to `127.0.0.1`, every call carries a bearer token, and nothing leaves the device.
bridge.transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP (also `GET /x/<action>` for a quick shot)
bridge.auth: Bearer token — shown and copied on the Bridge screen

groups.title: Screen
items: `brightness` — read or set screen brightness
`rotation` — lock to portrait or landscape, or auto
`filter` — a colour tint over the screen
`image` — a full-screen image overlay
`scene` — a full-screen image above the lock screen; wakes the screen
`screenshot` — capture the screen as a PNG
`record` — record the screen to an MP4
`wake` — turn the screen on
`torch` — flashlight on or off
`vibrate` — a haptic buzz

groups.title: Sound
items: `volume` — read or set a stream's volume
`ringer` — normal, vibrate or silent
`dnd` — Do Not Disturb
`media` — play, pause, next, prev
`speak` — text-to-speech in the phone's own voice

groups.title: Navigation & input (accessibility)
items: `access` — turn the service on; it also forwards the volume keys as triggers, even locked
`nav` — back, home, recents, notifications, quick settings, lock, power, split
`tap` / `swipe` — gestures at a pixel
`click` — tap a control by its on-screen text
`scroll` — scroll the content forward or backward
`type` — type into the focused field
`screen` — read the on-screen text and controls
`foreground` — the app on screen right now

groups.title: Apps & routes
items: `apps` — a manifest of every installed app and the deep-link protocols it answers
`open` — open a URL or an app route; it reaches the screen even from the background
`launch` — start an app by package name

groups.title: System
items: `lock` — lock the screen now (device admin)
`info` — device facts
`battery` — charge and power state
`wifi` — network state
`settings` — jump to a system settings page
`clip` — read or write the clipboard
`notifs` — read the notifications seen since start
`audit` — what can watch the device: accessibility, device admins, VPN

groups.title: Data
items: `contacts` — read the address book
`calendar` — read upcoming events
`call` — place a call

groups.title: Triggers
items: `/t/<key>` — a URL hook anything that opens a link can fire (browser, NFC tag, routine, shortcut); `events` drains them
`taps` — count screen taps to stop a scene
volume-key combos — N presses up then down, read through `events`, work on the lock screen
